CORRECTED BYTE-COURT PREFLIGHT — replaces post-01M1E2N20XB4XAPCSV8AX0S7BY. The reviewer is right: a digest without the literal replacement line was not independently reconstructible. The sole replacement line, with no leading or trailing bytes beyond the Markdown shown, is:

- **R3.1** Read narrowly under R3.5: **THE RESOLVER MAY MINT THE CONFORMANCE/REPLAY WITNESS ONLY.** It cannot mint provider or adjudicator authenticity. R3.5b is the controlling clause.

Replace the complete former R3.1 line once and preserve its terminating newline and every other source byte. Source: 26,290 UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 2ef4afd17313845e3a4b3650c918aa0e931dab06492d4c6b33442deaae36c214. Expected: 26,356 bytes, SHA-256 7f6782c367a6a20f9f6ac3aaf6f7734f17a9210265940b739804f5ce7c98aa4a. Old line count 1 before and 0 after; literal replacement count 0 before and 1 after; status line count 1. No claim, reservation, file write, decision, or implementation authority.
